zh.text: 全球市場混合，$NVDA 下跌 8% 至新的月度低點，油價走低。$SPX 從 7346 反彈至 7635，7571 現為關鍵持守水平。聯準會發言人成為焦點，因市場定價 12 月降息。觀察是否能從戰術交易轉向更積極的多頭方法進入年底。

en.text: Mixed global markets as $NVDA drops 8% to new monthly lows and oil moves lower. $SPX bounced from 7346 to 7635, with 7571 now a key level to hold. Fed speakers in focus as markets price in a December rate cut. Watching whether we can shift from tactical trading to a more active long approach into year-end.

zh.text: EliteOptions2 概述 CPI 週二交易計劃，指出上週四的拋售標誌底部。$SPX 反彈近 200 點，$QQQ 上漲 25 點以上，重訪低點機率低。目標包括 SPX 至 7620、$QQQ 至 700、$AMD 至 550、$SMH 至 520、$META 至 700、$NBIS 至 165-170。若 $SPX 守住 7400 且 $QQQ 高於 661，則回調可買入。

en.text: EliteOptions2 outlines a trade plan for CPI Tuesday, noting last Thursday's flush marked the bottom. $SPX rallied nearly 200 points and $QQQ 25+ points, with low probability of revisiting lows. Targets include SPX to 7620, $QQQ to 700, $AMD to 550, $SMH to 520, $META to 700, $NBIS to 165-170. Dips are buyable if $SPX holds 7400 and $QQQ above 661.

zh.text: Keith McCullough 感謝 Maggie @maggielake，並認為比特幣是即將到來的經濟 #Quad4 的最佳領先指標之一，相較於 $QQQ，2027 年初有兩個季度的此類情況待發生。

en.text: Keith McCullough thanks Maggie @maggielake and views Bitcoin as one of the best leading indicators of a pending economic #Quad4, with 2 quarterly ones pending to start 2027, compared to $QQQ.

zh.text: 早安！期貨：ES -0.4%，NQ -0.9%，YM持平。$NVDA盤前下跌6%，因董事會權衡Jensen Huang的未來；董事會整夜開會。10年期國債收益率5.01%（+2基點），退伍軍人節後債券重開。比特幣約7.38萬美元，持平。分析師動作包括$NVDA被Bernstein下調至Market Perform，目標價從400美元降至200美元；Oppenheimer下調至Perform並移除目標價；Stifel目標價從315美元降至205美元，維持Buy。$ORCL被DBS目標價從310美元降至290美元，Buy。$RKLB被摩根士丹利目標價從105美元降至103美元；Berenberg從83美元上調至85美元。其他多隻股票如$SE、$CVX、$KOS、$GIS、$RWT、$PTRN、$ENGN、$CAPR、$KE、$AGLT、$CRL、$AZTA、$JAZZ、$PLNT、$GCT、$MANE、$CI、$DGII、$HUT、$IONS有目標價調整。

en.text: Good Morning! Futures: ES -0.4%, NQ -0.9%, YM flat. $NVDA -6% premarket as board weighs Jensen Huang's future; board met all night. 10yr 5.01% (+2bps) as bonds reopen after Veterans Day. Bitcoin ~$73.8K flat. Analyst actions include $NVDA d/g Market Perform @ Bernstein pt $200 from $400; d/g Perform @ Oppenheimer pt removed; pt cut $205 from $315 @ Stifel keeps Buy. $ORCL pt cut $290 from $310 @ DBS Buy. $RKLB pt cut $103 from $105 @ Morgan Stanley; raised $85 from $83 @ Berenberg. Other PT cuts/raises for $SE, $CVX, $KOS, $GIS, $RWT, $PTRN, $ENGN, $CAPR, $KE, $AGLT, $CRL, $AZTA, $JAZZ, $PLNT, $GCT, $MANE, $CI, $DGII, $HUT, $IONS.

zh.text: 美股盤前上漲（SPX +0.4%、NDX +0.3%），因特朗普對伊朗較為和解的言論令布倫特原油下跌1.1%至97美元/桶，抵消了NVDA因執行長黃仁勳承認與一名疑似中國間諜有長期婚外情而下跌4.4%的影響；董事會正在調查，但認為未洩露公司機密或危害國家安全。晶片需求預計未來數年將超過供應，NVDA 2027年市盈率19倍具吸引力。能源價格回落及標普2026年盈利增長強勁（同比+33%）意味著20倍市盈率，應支持股市。對TSLA保持謹慎，因其估值偏高、盈利下修及自動駕駛技術商品化。

en.text: US stocks rose pre-market (SPX +0.4%, NDX +0.3%) as Brent crude fell 1.1% to $97/bbl on Trump’s more conciliatory Iran comments, offsetting $NVDA’s -4.4% drop after CEO Jensen Huang admitted an extended affair with a suspected Chinese spy; board investigating but sees no secrets or national security compromised. Chip demand expected to exceed supply for years, $NVDA 2027 P/E 19x compelling. Easing energy prices and strong S&P 2026 EPS growth (+33% YoY) implying 20x P/E should support equities. Remains cautious on $TSLA due to stretched valuation, negative earnings revisions, and commoditization of autonomous tech.

zh.text: 對那些傲慢年輕人的崩潰聲的抱怨，他們一直買入川普白宮看多的一切，從垃圾太空、無人機和加密股票到稀土礦物和數據中心玩法，現在甚至他們心愛的 $NVDA 也與其他 AI 晶片板塊一起受損。教訓已學到，市場之神會讓大聲和直言的人謙卑。

en.text: Rant that the blowup sound of cocky arrogant youngsters who kept buying everything the Trump White House is bullish on from garbage space, drone and crypto stocks to rare earth mineral and datacenter plays, and now even their beloved $NVDA taking a hickey with the rest of AI chip sector. Lessons learned as the market gods humble the loud and outspoken.

zh.text: HSBC 表示「不要浪費一個好的拋售」並列出 11 隻買入股票：$GOOGL Alphabet、$AMAT Applied Materials、$BKR Baker Hughes、$BE Bloom Energy、$C Citigroup、$FCX Freeport-McMoRan、$GEV GE Vernova、$NEE NextEra Energy、$ORCL Oracle、$SRE Sempra、$VRT Vertiv。HSBC 偏好超賣的 AI 基礎設施、半導體和電力相關股票，因為市場調整過度。

en.text: HSBC says “DON'T WASTE A GOOD SELL-OFF” and lists 11 stocks to buy: $GOOGL Alphabet, $AMAT Applied Materials, $BKR Baker Hughes, $BE Bloom Energy, $C Citigroup, $FCX Freeport-McMoRan, $GEV GE Vernova, $NEE NextEra Energy, $ORCL Oracle, $SRE Sempra, $VRT Vertiv. HSBC favors oversold AI infrastructure, semiconductors and power-related stocks as the market correction is overdone.
